summary: Iter47 frontend-only verification of the redesigned Ride Booking map+vehicle step (RideBookingPage.js step='map'). All 11 acceptance criteria from the review pass. Test was run as authenticated passenger (test_iter47@example.com / TestPass123!), route is /ride (NOT /ride/book which hits the RideTracking catchall). Captured live screenshot confirms the UI matches the supplied mockup.

issues: Destination address overlay is positioned at 50%/50% of a 55vh map container, which in some viewport sizes slightly overlaps the first vehicle row. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Prompt mentioned route '/ride/book' but the real route is '/ride' (App.js:145). '/ride/book' resolves to '/ride/:rideId' and shows 'Course introuvable'. If '/ride/book' is desired, add the alias route. Otherwise update the PRD to '/ride'.
critical_code_review_comments: getEstimateForAddress and getEstimate still hardcode payment_method: 'card' when calling rideAPI.estimate (RideBookingPage.js lines 138, 160). Only confirmRide uses the dynamic paymentMethod. Fare estimate may differ by payment rail in some pricing models; consider passing paymentMethod through to the estimate call too.

Unselected vehicle rows always display their static min_fare; only the selected row gets the real computed estimated_fare. User cannot compare vehicle pricing per-trip. Consider fetching a per-vehicle estimate map or using a distance-based local calc for the non-selected rows.

The map destination label uses `pointer-events-none` but sits at absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 of the 55vh map wrapper; on small viewports it overlaps the top of the bottom sheet's first vehicle row (see screenshot). Consider offsetting to top-1/3 or reducing max-w.
Recent locations still use synthetic `48.88 + Math.random()*0.02` coords (line 123); harmless for UI but produces non-deterministic distances. Should be replaced once places metadata is stored.
test_credentials: Created at runtime: test_iter47@example.com / TestPass123! (role=user). Register endpoint rejects .local TLDs so example.com was used.
seed_data_creation: 1 passenger user created via POST /api/auth/register. No ride records created (stopped before confirmRide to avoid side effects).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route for RideBookingPage is /ride (App.js:145). /ride/book hits RideTrackingPage with rideId='book' and renders 'Course introuvable'. Easiest way to reach step='map' deterministically: after login, visit /ride and click [data-testid^=recent-location-] (triggers handleDestinationFromRecent -> getEstimateForAddress -> setStep('map')). Vehicle type list loads from GET /api/config/vehicle-types (returns 10 slugs: sb, confort, luxe, moto, pool, suv, electric, van, accessible, airport). Verified testids: booking-bottom-sheet, vehicle-{slug}, payment-method-btn, request-now-btn, map-back-btn, ride-pickup-input, ride-dropoff-input.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature verification, no issues found. Verified: (1) bottom sheet title literal matches mockup, (2) 10 vehicle rows render with car icon + bold name + 'Proposez votre prix, negociez avec les chauffeurs' subtitle + User icon + capacity + orange #FF4500 fare + Info icon, (3) selecting a vehicle applies bg-orange-50 (confirmed with class inspection and visual), (4) payment toggle cycles cash(green Money)->card(blue CreditCard)->wallet(purple CreditCard)->cash correctly, (5) CTA reads 'Demander maintenant' with bg-[#FF4500], (6) map-back-btn renders Phosphor ArrowLeft svg (path d=M228,128... is ArrowLeft shape, NOT X), (7) ETA badge shows '22 min(s)' slate-800 box + '@Pour {dropoff.address}' white box, (8) destination label box visible and centered-ish over map, (9) confirmRide uses paymentMethod state (line 177) not hardcoded 'card', (10) plan step still renders both GooglePlacesInput inputs, (11) no console errors other than benign WS + preload 401 on /login.
